item.title: Protector
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Humans are stuck in the ‘breeder’ phase - Earth is a lost colony. A member of the species in the Protector stage (stronger, smarter, utilitarian) finds humanity and mentors us behind the scenes. Explores what it means to be a child species under the care of a vastly superior intelligence. Personal Reflection Read as a teenager while traveling to and from my construction job. Not the best book technically, but my first real introduction to serious science fiction. I remember visualizing the …
